about: Conditions: states applied to a creature for a while (or until removed). modifiers use the Orsino vocabulary (see src/rules/modifiers.ts); onTurnEnd damage or healing happens at the end of the holder's turn, or on each tick of a world-time clock. Orsino statuses are generated into data/catalog/orsino/conditions.json; this file holds Kyr's own conditions and deliberate adaptations of Orsino ones.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: Poison works through the body, hurting a little at a time until it is cured.

source.notes: A world condition that lasts beyond an encounter and is cured by an antidote; Orsino's poison ends with the fight.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.description: A wound that keeps bleeding until it is bound.

source.notes: A world condition treated by rest or a poultice; Orsino's bleed ends with the fight.
Exact 50% fire resistance. It persists beyond an encounter for as long as the applying salve or ward says, and one source refreshes rather than stacks.

Exact 50% cold resistance, as fireproof is to fire. It persists beyond an encounter for as long as the ward that applies it says (the cold ward), and one source refreshes rather than stacks: the Plane of Water's cold is the harm it is laid against (GT-01).

wayfarer_guard.name: Wayfarer's guard
wayfarer_guard.description: Veyra watches over the traveller: saves come easier.

lit.name: Lit
lit.description: A conjured light hangs over its bearer's shoulder for a while.

source.notes: Kyr's light: while it lasts, the company can see in unlit places.

lit.begins: A small steady light kindles over {target}'s shoulder.

lamplit.name: Lamplit
lamplit.description: Carrying a lit lantern: a steady light against the dark, and a flame to hand.
lamplit.begins: {target} fills a lantern and lights it.
lamplit.ends: {target}'s lantern burns dry and goes out.

source.notes: A flask of oil burns six hours in a lantern.

candlelit.name: Candlelit
candlelit.description: Carrying a lit candle: a small light against the dark.

source.notes: A candle burns about two hours.

torchlit.name: Torchlit
torchlit.description: Carrying a burning torch: light against the dark, and fire to hand.

source.notes: A torch burns about an hour: light in unlit places, and a flame for what needs burning.

unbarring.name: Unbarring
unbarring.description: Locks open at a touch for a while.
unbarring.begins: Locks will open at {target}'s touch for the next hour.
unbarring.ends: The unbarring on {target}'s hands is spent.

source.notes: The effect of Knock: for an hour its bearer opens what lockwork opens.

guarded.name: Guarded
guarded.description: Someone stands in front of them and takes the blows meant for them.
guarded.begins: Until their guard acts again, blows aimed at {target} meet the guard instead.

source.notes: Interception without positions: a blow aimed at the holder strikes whoever is guarding them.

fleeing.name: Fleeing
fleeing.description: Turned to flight: it will be gone from the fight when the next round begins.

source.notes: Orsino's flee effect (Ability.handleSingleEffect) gives its target this status, {flee: true}, for two turns; Combat removes a fleeing enemy when the next round begins.

unlit_law.name: The Unlit's law
unlit_law.description: In the Unlit fire burns small and cold, wounds close slowly, and fear comes easily.

source.notes: A place law, as Orsino's planes carry global effects every resident holds (planeModifiers.globalEffects): fire resisted by half, healing two less, will saves two worse.

beacon_law.name: Under the beacon
beacon_law.description: Lampfall's beacon burns: in its light the dead are slow and the living steady.

source.notes: The law of the Unlit where Lampfall's beacon has been relit.

plane_arcadia.name: Arcadia
plane_arcadia.description: The law of Arcadia, a lush, idyllic realm of eternal spring, where nature thrives and harmony reigns.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_arcadia)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

plane_cthelll.name: Cthelll
plane_cthelll.description: The law of Cthelll, a dark, swampy plane shrouded in mist and mystery, home to ancient secrets and lurking dangers.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_cthelll)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there.

plane_gehenna.name: Gehenna
plane_gehenna.description: The law of Gehenna, a fiery, volcanic landscape filled with treacherous terrain and the echoes of eternal conflict.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_gehenna)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there.

plane_hades.name: Hades
plane_hades.description: The law of Hades, a shadowy underworld of gloom and despair, where lost souls wander and forgotten knowledge lies buried.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_hades)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

plane_limbo.name: Limbo
plane_limbo.description: The law of Limbo, a chaotic desert wasteland where the sands shift unpredictably and reality bends to whimsy.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_limbo)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

plane_mechanus.name: Mechanus
plane_mechanus.description: The law of Mechanus, a realm of perfect order and precision, where everything operates like clockwork in harmonious balance.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_mechanus)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

plane_pandemonium.name: Pandemonium
plane_pandemonium.description: The law of Pandemonium, a tumultuous plane of howling winds and swirling chaos, where nothing remains constant for long.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_pandemonium)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

plane_fire.name: the Fire
plane_fire.description: The law of the Plane of Fire: heat that burns whoever stands in it, a little at a time, and a working of the will that burns through what would hold it.

source.notes: An inner plane's law, laid on the plane in the canon (law(inner_fire, plane_fire)), so it holds for every author's places within it: its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there, as Gehenna's is; and its heat burns (1 fire) at the end of each turn in a fight and each watch out of one (GT-01), through the ordinary damage pipeline, so that a fire ward (fireproof) stops it.

plane_air.name: the Air
plane_air.description: The law of the Plane of Air: no ground and no stillness, and every spell flung on a wind that is not the caster's.

source.notes: An inner plane's law, laid on the plane in the canon (law(inner_air, plane_air)), so it holds for every author's places within it: its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there, as Pandemonium's is.

plane_water.name: the Water
plane_water.description: The law of the Plane of Water: no air and no surface, and a cold that works into whoever comes there.

source.notes: An inner plane's law (law(inner_water, plane_water)): its cold (1 cold) at the end of each turn in a fight and each watch out of one (GT-01), stopped by a ward against cold (waterproof). Adapted: the SRD's Water drowns whoever cannot breathe it; the engine has no rule for breath, so its harm is its cold.

plane_earth.name: the Earth
plane_earth.description: The law of the Plane of Earth: rock on every side, and a stillness that holds a working fast once it is made.

source.notes: An inner plane's law (law(inner_earth, plane_earth)), judged (GT-01): the rock presses but does not wound, so it does no harm by the watch; its stillness holds a spell harder, as Mechanus's order does (+1 spell DC).

plane_positive.name: the Positive
plane_positive.description: The law of the Positive Energy Plane: a light that runs into whoever stands in it like strength, and mends them.

source.notes: An inner plane's law (law(inner_positive, plane_positive)): it mends (1 health) at the end of each turn in a fight and each watch out of one (GT-01). Not done: the SRD's overload (hit points past the most, then bursting).

plane_negative.name: the Negative
plane_negative.description: The law of the Negative Energy Plane: a cold dark that draws the life out of whoever stands in it.

source.notes: An inner plane's law (law(inner_negative, plane_negative)): it drains (1 necrotic) at the end of each turn in a fight and each watch out of one (GT-01), stopped by a ward against the dark (darkproof, protected). Adapted: the SRD's Negative takes levels, stopped by death ward; here it takes health.

plane_prime_material.name: Prime Material
plane_prime_material.description: The law of Prime Material, the mundane world of everyday life, where magic is present but not overwhelming.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_prime_material)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

plane_ysgard.name: Ysgard
plane_ysgard.description: The law of Ysgard, a frigid, mountainous realm of valor and heroism, where mighty warriors clash amidst snowstorms.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_ysgard)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

plane_zephyrus.name: Zephyrus
plane_zephyrus.description: The law of Zephyrus, a vibrant forested plane perpetually stirred by thunderstorms, alive with elemental energy.

source.notes: A plane as a place's law (law(place, plane_zephyrus)): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there. Its spell durations and spare spell slots are not modelled.

asleep.name: Asleep
asleep.description: In a deep slumber, unaware of surroundings, until a blow wakes them.

source.notes: Orsino's asleep (no actions; its sleep save), and the SRD's Sleep's waking (mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 14): a blow that wounds a sleeper and leaves them standing wakes them (its onAttacked hook, answering harm from another creature). Omitted: the sleeper helpless, and waking by a slap or a noise.

calmed.name: Calmed
calmed.description: Quieted by a calm laid on them: does nothing until harm or a blow breaks it.

source.notes: The SRD's Calm Emotions' calm (mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 24): no actions, and any harm or blow from another breaks it (its onAttacked hook, as asleep's). Converted: the SRD's calmed may defend itself and do anything not violent; Kyr's does nothing. Omitted: a blow on one breaking it on every calmed creature.
The SRD's Remove Fear's courage (mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 21): +4 against fear (Kyr's fear save, made with Wisdom), the SRD's morale bonus; it ends with the fight.

warded_from_evil.name: Warded from evil
warded_from_evil.description: A ward of faith stands about them: two harder to hit, +2 to every save, and no voice can bend their will.
warded_from_evil.begins: A ward of faith stands about {target}.

source.notes: The SRD's Protection from Evil's ward (mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 32): +2 to armour class by a deflection (Kyr's armour class descends, so ac -2), +2 to every save (the SRD's resistance bonus), and proof against charm (its mental control). Adapted: against every foe, where the SRD's is against the evil; it adds to Shield of Faith's deflection, where the SRD's two deflections do not stack.

baned.name: Baned
baned.description: A dread is on them: their blows go wider, and fear finds them easier.

source.notes: The SRD's Bane (srd-proving-cases.md, case 39): −1 to hit, and −1 on saves against fear (the SRD's morale penalty, on its attack rolls and its saves against fear).

acid_clinging.name: Clinging Acid
acid_clinging.description: Acid clings and eats at them: 2d4 at the end of each of their turns.

source.notes: The SRD's Acid Arrow's acid that stays (srd-proving-cases.md, case 44): 2d4 acid at the end of each round it lasts, laid for a round every three casting levels (Lasting). It sets off none of Orsino's acid burn, which the SRD's has not.

concealed.name: Concealed
concealed.description: Blurred and wavering: one blow in five meant for them goes astray.
concealed.begins: {target} blurs and wavers, hard to make out.

source.notes: The SRD's concealment (srd-proving-cases.md, cases 49 and 57), as Blur lays it: a 20 % miss chance, thrown on d100 after a blow lands (exact; it had been Westernesse's evasion of 3, four hits in twenty turned).

fire_resistant.name: Fire-Resistant
fire_resistant.description: Fire's heat is held off: ten less from each burn.
fire_resistant.begins: A cool stillness settles about {target}, and the heat is held off.
fire_resistant.ends: The stillness about {target} is gone, and the heat comes back.

source.notes: The SRD's Resist Energy against fire (srd-proving-cases.md, case 38): ten off each blow of fire, after any fraction, the better of two such resistances and never both (Defenses.mitigate). It persists past a fight's end for what is left of its rounds, as the fireproof ward does, so it may be laid before a fight (FieldUse). Converted: ten at every casting level, where the SRD's is twenty from the seventh and thirty from the eleventh.

mirror_images.name: Mirror Images
mirror_images.description: Figments of their maker stand all about them, and blows meant for them fall on the figments.

source.notes: The SRD's Mirror Image (srd-proving-cases.md, case 40): 1d4 images and one each three casting levels, to eight; each attack roll at the holder falls on it or an image, each as likely, and a hit on an image puts it out (Images). Before, Orsino's two harder to hit, +2 to every save and an evasion of 15.

mage_armored.name: Mage-Armored
mage_armored.description: An unseen armour of force: as good as a mail coat, worn over nothing.
mage_armored.begins: An unseen armour of force closes about {target}.
mage_armored.ends: The armour of force about {target} is gone.

source.notes: The SRD's Mage Armor (srd-proving-cases.md, case 22): a +4 armour bonus of force, worn armour's equal, not added to it (Fighting.armorClass); no temporary hit points. Before, Orsino's four harder to hit added to worn armour and twenty temporary hit points.

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.description: A shimmer of faith turns blows aside: two harder to hit, whatever armour is worn.
shield_of_faith.begins: A shimmer of faith stands about {target}.

source.notes: The SRD's Shield of Faith's deflection (mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 19): +2 to armour class (Kyr's armour class descends, so ac -2), added to worn armour as a deflection is. Converted: +2 at every casting level (the SRD's grows a point each six levels to +5). Orsino's Shield of Faith had laid its shielded, which its abyssal shield still lays.

death_ward.name: Death Ward
death_ward.description: Warded against death's own powers: the dark's harm does not touch the warded, and nothing takes a level of them.

source.notes: The SRD's Death Ward, what it wards (mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 8): immunity to negative energy (Westernesse's necrotic harm, the Negative's law among it: GT-01) and to energy drain (an enervate takes no level, told as an immunity). Kept: Orsino's +5 to the death save at no health. Adapted: Westernesse has no death spells, so the SRD's immunity to them is the death save's bonus. Not changed: the spell (Orsino's second-level divine Death Ward of three turns; the SRD's is fourth level, a minute a level), so it wards a fight, not a watch.

plane_abyss.name: the Abyss
plane_abyss.description: The law of the Abyss: a drop that has no bottom, where a working frays at its edges as everything else does.

source.notes: A plane of Kyr's own beyond Orsino's nine (law(outer_abyss, plane_abyss), GT-03): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there, as Pandemonium's chaos holds it lower. The SRD's Abyss is chaotic and evil in its alignment traits, which Westernesse has no rule for.

plane_nirvana.name: Nirvana
plane_nirvana.description: The law of Nirvana: a stillness so whole that a working, once made, holds fast.

source.notes: A plane of Kyr's own beyond Orsino's nine (law(outer_nirvana, plane_nirvana), GT-03): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there, as Mechanus's order holds it higher. Its SRD counterpart's lawful alignment trait has no Westernesse rule.

plane_exalted.name: the Mount of the Exalted
plane_exalted.description: The law of the Mount of the Exalted: a high clear light in which a working is seen through to its end.

source.notes: A plane of Kyr's own beyond Orsino's nine (law(outer_exalted, plane_exalted), GT-03): its spell DC is held by everyone fighting there, as Arcadia's is. The SRD's Mount Celestia is lawful and good in its alignment traits, which Westernesse has no rule for.

slain.name: Dead
slain.description: Fallen, and not come round: beyond waking now, and only a raising of the dead will bring them back.
slain.begins: {target} does not come round, and will not: they have died where they fell.

source.notes: Orsino's system shock: one who has fallen and fails it at a rest has bled out (Dungeoneer.rest, Tavern, SystemShock).

in_the_dark.name: In the dark
in_the_dark.description: Fighting without a light: striking at sounds, and slow to see a blow coming.

source.notes: Kyr's own: a company with no light where it fights (benighted) fights under it (Mission 20: darkness had cost nothing).

tended.name: Tended
tended.description: A healing cantrip has done what it can for them since the company last rested: another will not mend them again until a rest, a night, or a healer's care.

source.notes: Kyr's own (R10-12, R11-05, the lead's ruling of 13 November): a healing cantrip mends each member once between rests in the field; in a fight cantrips are at will. Lifted by a rest's recovery and a night in the open (vocabulary.json's camp_recovery and rough_rest).

weary.name: Weary
weary.description: Too long without sleep: slow to strike and slow to dodge, until a night's sleep.

source.notes: Kyr's own: a company weary for want of sleep (needs.kyr) fights under it.

ready.name: Ready
ready.description: Waiting for it with weapons out, where the company chose to meet it: quick to strike first, and steadier for it.

source.notes: Kyr's own: a company that drew something out to meet it where it waited (inhabitants.kyr) fights under it.

drained.name: Drained
drained.description: Levels taken by the touch of the dead: weaker in a fight, in spells and in health by each, until a restoration gives them back.
drained.begins: The cold goes into {target}, and a level of what they were goes out of them, until a restoration gives it back.

source.notes: Kyr's own energy drain (see LevelDrain): it counts the levels taken; until a restoration lifts it its holder stands that many levels lower, beyond the fight and in a saved game.
